visual.name: bfusionHomePageIntro
visual.description: Branded home-page visual: one-shot intro animation introduces the BFusion Smart Visuals suite, then collapses to a hero with data-driven navigation tiles (filter-based, NavigationMenu-pattern).

enabled.description: Full-screen splash played once on first render. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

replayOnUpdate.description: If on, intro replays whenever the visual re-renders (filter change, resize). Off = once per session.
